name: Shake and shrink text
what: One bold word pops up from a dot on a dark ground, then shakes harder and harder, smeared by motion blur and swelling as it goes, and finally snaps to the centre and shrinks away to nothing.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1-f17 the text grows from a dot with a 10 % overshoot (cubic-bezier(0.641, 0.011, 0.248, 1.444)); f19-f78 it shakes up / down and sideways, more and more wildly, with motion blur along the jumps, while swelling 29 % (accelerating); f78 it snaps back to the centre; f79-f88 it shrinks away to nothing (decelerating); then black to f91

tracks.name: pop in
tracks.what: the text grows from a dot to full size with a 10 % overshoot

tracks.name: shake
tracks.what: random jumps up / down and sideways, growing to 17 % of the height, with motion blur
tracks.easing: ramp-up (accelerating), a new jump every 2 f

tracks.name: swell
tracks.what: the text grows 29 % while it shakes
